structure ComplexFloat where
  re : Float
  im : Float
deriving DecidableEq

def ComplexFloat.init (re im : Float) : ComplexFloat := ⟨re, im⟩

def ComplexFloat.add (a b : ComplexFloat) : ComplexFloat :=
  { re := Float.add a.re b.re, im := Float.add a.im b.im }

def ComplexFloat.sub (a b : ComplexFloat) : ComplexFloat :=
  { re := Float.sub a.re b.re, im := Float.sub a.im b.im }

def ComplexFloat.mul (a b : ComplexFloat) : ComplexFloat :=
  { re := Float.sub (Float.mul a.re b.re) (Float.mul a.im b.im),
    im := Float.add (Float.mul a.re b.im) (Float.mul a.im b.re) }

def ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared (c : ComplexFloat) : Float :=
  Float.magnitudeSquared c.re c.im

def ComplexFloat.magnitude (c : ComplexFloat) : Float :=
  Float.magnitude c.re c.im

structure Qubit where
  a : ComplexFloat
  b : ComplexFloat
deriving DecidableEq

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  Float.add (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared q.a) (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared q.b)

def Qubit.normalizeInPlace (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := q.normSquared
  if Float.le ns (Float.ofReal 0) || Float.isNan ns || Float.isInf ns then
    { a := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.ofReal 0),
      b := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 0) }
  else
    let inv := Float.div (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.sqrt ns)
    let s := ComplexFloat.init inv (Float.ofReal 0)
    { a := ComplexFloat.mul q.a s,
      b := ComplexFloat.mul q.b s }

def Qubit.init (a b : ComplexFloat) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.normalizeInPlace { a := a, b := b }

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  { a := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.ofReal 0),
    b := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 0) }

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  { a := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 0),
    b := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.ofReal 0) }

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  Float.clamp (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared q.a) (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 1)

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  Float.clamp (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared q.b) (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 1)

def Qubit.invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  Float.toReal (Qubit.prob0 q) + Float.toReal (Qubit.prob1 q) ≤ 1.01 ∧
  Float.toReal (Qubit.prob0 q) ≥ 0 ∧
  Float.toReal (Qubit.prob1 q) ≥ 0

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Fin 4 → ComplexFloat
deriving DecidableEq

def TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := Float.div (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.sqrt (Float.ofReal 2))
  { amps := fun i => 
      match i with
      | 0 => ComplexFloat.init inv_sqrt2 (Float.ofReal 0)
      | 1 => ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 0)
      | 2 => ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 0)
      | 3 => ComplexFloat.init inv_sqrt2 (Float.ofReal 0) }

def TwoQubit.normSquared (tq : TwoQubit) : Float :=
  Float.add (Float.add (Float.add 
    (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared (tq.amps 0))
    (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared (tq.amps 1)))
    (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared (tq.amps 2)))
    (ComplexFloat.magnitudeSquared (tq.amps 3))

def TwoQubit.invariant (tq : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  let ns := TwoQubit.normSquared tq
  Float.toReal ns ≥ 0.99 ∧ Float.toReal ns ≤ 1.01

abbrev Gate := Qubit → Qubit

def hadamardGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let inv_sqrt2 := Float.div (Float.ofReal 1) (Float.sqrt (Float.ofReal 2))
  let s := ComplexFloat.init inv_sqrt2 (Float.ofReal 0)
  let a := ComplexFloat.mul (ComplexFloat.add q.a q.b) s
  let b := ComplexFloat.mul (ComplexFloat.sub q.a q.b) s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliXGate : Gate := fun q =>
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliYGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let i := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal 1)
  let minus_i := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal 0) (Float.ofReal (-1))
  Qubit.init (ComplexFloat.mul minus_i q.b) (ComplexFloat.mul i q.a)

def pauliZGate : Gate := fun q =>
  let minus_one := ComplexFloat.init (Float.ofReal (-1)) (Float.ofReal 0)
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexFloat.mul q.b minus_one)

def identityGate : Gate := fun q => q

def phaseGate (phase : Float) : Gate := fun q =>
  let c := Float.cos phase
  let s := Float.sin phase
  let e := ComplexFloat.init c s
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexFloat.mul q.b e)

  Qubit.invariant (identityGate q) := by
  rw [identityGate_preserves_qubit]

          · by_cases b < a
            · contradiction
            · rfl
          · contradiction
        | inr hlt =>
          contradiction
  · by_cases hba : b < a
    · have : ¬(a < b) := hab
      by_cases a < b
      · contradiction
      · by_cases b < a
        · rfl
        · contradiction
    · have : ¬(a < b) := hab
      have : ¬(b < a) := hba
      have : a = b := by
        cases String.lt_trichotomy a b with
        | inl h => contradiction
        | inr h =>
          cases h with
          | inl heq => exact heq
          | inr h => contradiction
      rw [this]
      by_cases b < b
      · have := String.lt_irrefl b
        contradiction
      · by_cases b < b
        · have := String.lt_irrefl b
          contradiction
        · rfl

theorem PairKey.canonical_idempotent (a b : String) :
  let pk := PairKey.canonical a b
  PairKey.canonical pk.a pk.b = pk := by
  unfold PairKey.canonical
  by_cases hab : a < b
  · have h1 : (if a < b then ⟨a, b⟩ else ⟨b, a⟩) = ⟨a, b⟩ := by
      by_cases a < b
      · rfl
      · contradiction
    rw [h1]
    have : (if a < b then ⟨a, b⟩ else ⟨b, a⟩) = ⟨a, b⟩ := h1
    have h2 : (⟨a, b⟩ : PairKey).a = a := rfl
    have h3 : (⟨a, b⟩ : PairKey).b = b := rfl
    by_cases a < b
    · rfl
    · contradiction
  · have h1 : (if a < b then ⟨a, b⟩ else ⟨b, a⟩) = ⟨b, a⟩ := by
      by_cases a < b
      · contradiction
      · rfl
    rw [h1]
    by_cases a = b
    · rw [h]
      have : ¬(b < b) := String.lt_irrefl b
      by_cases b < b
      · contradiction
      · rfl
    · have : b < a := by
        cases String.lt_trichotomy a b with
        | inl hlt => contradiction
        | inr hor =>
          cases hor with
          | inl heq => contradiction
          | inr hgt => exact hgt
      by_cases b < a
      · rfl
      · contradiction

theorem NodeMap.empty_invariant : NodeMap.invariant NodeMap.empty := by
  unfold NodeMap.invariant
  unfold NodeMap.empty
  intro entry h
  cases h

theorem NodeMap.insert_preserves_invariant (nm : NodeMap) (k : String) (n : Node)
  (hnm : NodeMap.invariant nm) (hkey : k = n.id) (hn : Node.invariant n) :
  NodeMap.invariant (nm.insert k n) := by
  unfold NodeMap.invariant
  unfold NodeMap.insert
  intro entry h
  cases h with
  | inl heq =>
    have : entry = (k, n) := heq
    rw [this]
    constructor
    · exact hkey
    · exact hn
  | inr hmem =>
    have : entry ∈ List.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) nm.entries := hmem
    have hmem_in_original : entry ∈ nm.entries := by
      have := List.mem_filter.mp this
      exact this.1
    have := hnm entry hmem_in_original
    exact this

theorem NodeMap.get_insert_same (nm : NodeMap) (k : String) (n : Node) :
  (nm.insert k n).get k = some n := by
  unfold NodeMap.insert
  unfold NodeMap.get
  have step1 : ((k, n) :: nm.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = [(k, n)] := by
    apply List.ext_get
    · have len_eq_one : (((k, n) :: nm.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k)).length = 1 := by
        induction nm.entries with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons head tail ih =>
          by_cases hc : head.1 ≠ k
          · have filtered_with_head : (⟨k, n⟩ :: (head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = (⟨k, n⟩ :: head :: tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) := by rfl
            have head_filtered : (head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) = head :: tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) := by
              have : head.1 ≠ k := hc
              rfl
            rw [← head_filtered]
            have result : (⟨k, n⟩ :: (head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = ⟨k, n⟩ :: ((head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) := by rfl
            rw [result]
            have no_matches_in_filtered : ((head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = [] := by
              apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
              intro x hx
              have := List.mem_filter.mp hx
              intro heq
              have : x.1 = k := heq
              have : x.1 ≠ k := this.2
              contradiction
            rw [no_matches_in_filtered]
            rfl
          · have : head.1 = k := by
              by_contra h
              have : head.1 ≠ k := h
              contradiction
            have filtered_without_head : ((⟨k, n⟩ :: (head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k))).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = (⟨k, n⟩ :: tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) := by
              have : (head :: tail).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) = tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) := by
                have : ¬(head.1 ≠ k) := hc
                rfl
              rw [this]
            rw [filtered_without_head]
            have result : (⟨k, n⟩ :: tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = ⟨k, n⟩ :: (tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) := by rfl
            rw [result]
            have no_matches : (tail.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k) = [] := by
              apply List.filter_eq_nil_iff.mpr
              intro x hx
              have := List.mem_filter.mp hx
              intro heq
              have : x.1 = k := heq
              have : x.1 ≠ k := this.2
              contradiction
            rw [no_matches]
            rfl
      exact len_eq_one
    · intro n h1 h2
      have : n < 1 := by
        have : (((k, n) :: nm.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k)).filter (fun p => p.1 = k)).length = 1 := by
          exact len_eq_one
        rw [this] at h1
        omega
      have : n = 0 := by omega
      rw [this]
      rfl
  rw [step1]
  rfl

  unfold NodeMap.empty
  unfold NodeMap.get
  rfl

theorem EdgeList.empty_invariant : EdgeList.invariant EdgeList.empty := by

  unfold EdgeList.empty

  cases h

theorem EdgeList.append_preserves_invariant (el : EdgeList) (e : Edge)
  (hel : EdgeList.invariant el) (he : Edge.invariant e) :
  EdgeList.invariant (el.append e) := by
  unfold EdgeList.invariant
  unfold EdgeList.append
  intro edge h
  have : edge ∈ el.edges ++ [e] := h
  have : edge ∈ el.edges ∨ edge ∈ [e] := List.mem_append.mp this
  cases this with
  | inl hmem =>
    exact hel edge hmem
  | inr hmem =>
    have : edge = e := by
      cases hmem with

      | tail _ h => cases h
    rw [this]

deriving DecidableEq

  | none => EdgeList.empty

  let current := em.getOrEmpty key
  let updated := current.append edge

def EdgeMap.size (em : EdgeMap) : Nat :=

theorem EdgeMap.empty_invariant : EdgeMap.invariant EdgeMap.empty := by

theorem EdgeMap.getOrEmpty_invariant (em : EdgeMap) (k : EdgeKey)
  (hem : EdgeMap.invariant em) :
  EdgeList.invariant (em.getOrEmpty k) := by
  unfold EdgeMap.getOrEmpty
  split
  · rename_i h
    obtain ⟨_, el⟩ := h
    have step1 : ∃ entry ∈ em.entries, entry.1 = k ∧ entry.2 = el := by
      have : (_, el) ∈ (em.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = k)) := by
        have : List.head? (em.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = k)) = some (_, el) := h
        cases em.entries.filter (fun p => p.1 = k) with
        | nil => contradiction
        | cons hd tl =>
          have : List.head? (hd :: tl) = some hd := rfl
          rw [this] at h
          injection h with heq
          rw [← heq]
          apply List.Mem.head
      have := List.mem_filter.mp this
      obtain ⟨hmem, hkey⟩ := this
      use (_, el)
      constructor
      · exact hmem
      · constructor
        · exact hkey
        · rfl
    obtain ⟨entry, hmem, _, heq⟩ := step1
    rw [← heq]
    exact hem entry hmem
  · exact EdgeList.empty_invariant

theorem EdgeMap.insert_preserves_invariant (em : EdgeMap) (k : EdgeKey) (e : Edge)
  (hem : EdgeMap.invariant em) (he : Edge.invariant e) :
  EdgeMap.invariant (em.insert k e) := by
  unfold EdgeMap.invariant
  unfold EdgeMap.insert
  intro entry h
  cases h with
  | inl heq =>
    have : entry = (k, (em.getOrEmpty k).append e) := heq
    rw [this]
    have hcurrent := EdgeMap.getOrEmpty_invariant em k hem
    exact EdgeList.append_preserves_invariant (em.getOrEmpty k) e hcurrent he
  | inr hmem =>
    have : entry ∈ List.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ k) em.entries := hmem
    have := List.mem_filter.mp this
    have hmem_original := this.1
    exact hem entry hmem_original

theorem EdgeMap.size_nonneg (em : EdgeMap) : em.size ≥ 0 := by
  unfold EdgeMap.size
  induction em.entries with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head tail ih =>
    have : List.foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.2.size) 0 (head :: tail) = List.foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.2.size) (0 + head.2.size) tail := by rfl
    rw [this]
    have : 0 + head.2.size = head.2.size := by omega
    rw [this]
    have : head.2.size ≥ 0 := EdgeList.size_nonneg head.2
    have : List.foldl (fun acc p => acc + p.2.size) 0 tail ≥ 0 := ih
    omega

def TopologyHash := String

def computeTopologyHash (nodes : NodeMap) (edges : EdgeMap) (ent : EntanglementMap) : TopologyHash :=
  let nodeStr := toString nodes.size
  let edgeStr := toString edges.size
  let entStr := toString ent.size
  nodeStr ++ "_" ++ edgeStr ++ "_" ++ entStr

axiom TopologyHash.length_positive : ∀ h : TopologyHash, h.length > 0

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : NodeMap
  edges : EdgeMap
  entanglements : EntanglementMap
  quantum_register : QuantumRegister
  topology_hash : TopologyHash
deriving DecidableEq

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  { nodes := NodeMap.empty,
    edges := EdgeMap.empty,
    entanglements := EntanglementMap.empty,
    quantum_register := QuantumRegister.empty,
    topology_hash := computeTopologyHash NodeMap.empty EdgeMap.empty EntanglementMap.empty }

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Prop :=
  NodeMap.invariant g.nodes ∧
  EdgeMap.invariant g.edges ∧
  EntanglementMap.invariant g.entanglements ∧
  QuantumRegister.invariant g.quantum_register ∧
  g.nodes.size ≥ 0 ∧
  g.edges.size ≥ 0 ∧
  g.entanglements.size ≥ 0 ∧
  g.quantum_register.size ≥ 0 ∧
  g.topology_hash.length > 0

theorem SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init_invariant :
  SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init := by
  unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant
  unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.init
  constructor
  · exact NodeMap.empty_invariant
  · constructor
    · exact EdgeMap.empty_invariant
    · constructor
      · exact EntanglementMap.empty_invariant
      · constructor
        · exact QuantumRegister.empty_invariant
        · constructor
          · exact NodeMap.size_nonneg NodeMap.empty
          · constructor
            · exact EdgeMap.size_nonneg EdgeMap.empty
            · constructor
              · exact EntanglementMap.size_nonneg EntanglementMap.empty
              · constructor
                · exact QuantumRegister.size_nonneg QuantumRegister.empty
                · exact TopologyHash.length_positive (computeTopologyHash NodeMap.empty EdgeMap.empty EntanglementMap.empty)

  (hg : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant g) :
  SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant (g.updateTopologyHash) := by
  unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant at *
  unfold SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.updateTopologyHash
  obtain ⟨hn, he, hent, hqr, hns, hes, hents, hqrs, _⟩ := hg
  constructor
  · exact hn
  · constructor
    · exact he
    · constructor
      · exact hent
      · constructor
        · exact hqr
        · constructor
          · exact hns
          · constructor
            · exact hes
            · constructor
              · exact hents
              · constructor
                · exact hqrs
                · exact TopologyHash.length_positive (computeTopologyHash g.nodes g.edges g.entanglements)

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.addNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (n : Node) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let updated_nodes := g.nodes.insert n.id n
  let updated_qr := g.quantum_register.insert n.id n.qubit

  (hg : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.invariant g) (hn : Node.invariant n) :

            · exact hges

                · exact hgh

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.applyGate (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (nodeId : String) (gate : Gate) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=

theorem SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.applyGate_preserves_invariant (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) 
  (nodeId : String) (gate : Gate)
